title: Arithmetic Supports of Lax Difference Hierarchies
summary: We classify monic finite-band scalar difference operators with independent coefficients admitting infinitely many support-preserving flows. We prove that such operators are completely characterized by an arithmetic condition on their support: the exponents must form an arithmetic progression. Conversely, every arithmetic support gives rise to an infinite hierarchy of local Lax flows.
